title: GTA 6 Broke Records Before It Even Came Out
lines: GTA 6 isn't even out yet, and it already broke the internet.
Its first trailer pulled more than ninety million YouTube views in twenty four hours.
At the time, that was a record for a non-music video.
Then trailer two hit four hundred seventy five million views across platforms, in a single day.
Why so much hype? GTA 5 has sold more than two hundred million copies.
When it launched, it made one billion dollars in just three days.
And fans waited thirteen years for the next one.
November nineteenth. Are you playing day one? Follow for more!
caption:
GTA 6 broke records before launch 📈 Trailer 1: ~93M YouTube views in 24 hours (a non-music record at the time). Trailer 2: 475M views across platforms in one day. GTA 5: 200M+ copies and $1B in 3 days. Out November 19.

Fan-made explainer, not affiliated with Rockstar Games. Sources: Rockstar Games, Take-Two Interactive reports, Guinness World Records.
